title: Grateful Dead Live at University Hall, University Of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: DAT (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a lo‑high‑energy 1982 Virginia show featuring smoking Lazy Lightning, Supplication and a killer High Time.
ai_review.review: The patched SBD release delivers a very clear, upgraded sonic picture of the September 1982 Virginia concert, despite the first couple of songs being cut off. The performance is described as loose, slippery and high‑energy, with standout moments on Lazy Lightning → Supplication → Deal and an especially powerful High Time.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give 4–5 stars and praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; minor recording gaps keep it from a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, upgraded SBD source praised as very high quality, though the first couple of songs are cut off in the release.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Loose and slippery feel with a high‑energy flow that kept the crowd buzzing; the show feels like a classic fall‑82 Dead performance.
